<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex212-2024-10-02-12-45" status="finalized">
         dang po ni gang ma thos pa ces pa nas 'dir shog ces pa'i bar te | 'di'i don nges par bya ba yang | gzhan gyi 'dod pa dgag pa dang | rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa'o |
            <milestone n="1. " unit="section"/>
            dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ref="db:3786" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">lo tsha ba</rs></note> na re chos <lb n="1b6"/> nyan pa la spro ba bskyed pa ni || chos nyan pa'i 'bras bu dang | chos <choice><corr>kyi</corr><sic>kya</sic></choice> rang bzhin bzang pa dang | nyan pa po skal ba dang ldan par brjod pa'i sgo nas te | dang po ni 'bras bu mi 'dod pa spong pa dang | 'dod pa sgrub pa'i bdag nyid do ||
         de'i yang dang po ni <choice><reg>sdug bsngal</reg><orig>sdug ×bsngal</orig></choice> gyi ngo bo dang | de'i rgyu spong pa gnyis kyis te | dang po ni <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a3">gang ma thos pas</quote> ces pa yin la || <lb n="1b7"/> de yang chos ma thos na 'di lta bu'i nyes pa 'byung zhes shes dmigs dngos su brjod pas shugs kyis thos na sdug bsngal spong par bstan ste | des na <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a3">de ni mnyan phyir gus pas skyed <note type="editorial">D (ID:3742): de ni mnyan phyir gus pa shin tu rgya cher bsten</note></quote> ces pa ni skabs kyi don to || 
gnyis pa ni <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a3">gang thos nas kyang</quote> ces pa yin no || 
'dod pa sgrub pa ni <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a4">bde ba las ni</quote> ces pa yin la | chos kyi rang bzhin bzung pa ni <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a5">shin tu</quote> <lb n="1b8"/> <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a3">snyed dka'i <note type="editorial">D (ID: 3742): shin tu rnyed dka'i</note></quote> ces pa yin zhing | nyan pa po skal ba dang ldan bar brjod pa ni <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a5">dal thob</quote> ces pa'o || 
            de ltar gsum gyis nye bar gnas pa'i skye bo dag chos nyan par spos ba bsgrubs nas | nye bar mi gnas pa rjes su bzung pa ni <quote source="db:3742" n="D3a5">khams gsum</quote> ces pa yin no | zhes <abbr>zer ro</abbr> ||</seg></TEI>
